exposure: Season (winter, autumn, February, January, September, November)
Incidents and disorders of the placenta and umbilical cord
cohort: The study included 10,988 files of children born to Iranian women at Ayatollah Taleghani Hospital, Ilam City, between June 2017 and May 2020.
finding: Hypertensive disorders of pregnancy showed a seasonal pattern, with the highest prevalence in winter (4.70%), specifically February (5.46%) and January (5.05%), and the lowest in autumn (2.57%).
mod_finding: Delivery method had a significant relationship with hypertensive disorders during pregnancy.
